problems.problem: Bottle appears to float above the burgundy surface. Visible shadow offset_y is 0, but the bottle base (y=820) is 405 pixels above the canvas bottom (1440), creating an unrealistic gap. No contact cues (e.g., surface reflection, shadow merging) confirm grounding.
Bottle occupies only 59% of canvas height (850/1440), below the 50-65% hero standard. The large empty space below the bottle disrupts visual balance and reduces product prominence.

Compared to professional references (e.g., Tom Ford Figue, Byredo Rose of No Man's Land), the composition lacks a strong conceptual link between product and background. The burgundy backdrop feels generic rather than thematically integrated with the perfume.
Title 'J'adore' (size 62) and logo 'Dior' (size 34) are too small relative to the bottle, reducing hierarchy. The subtitle 'EAU DE PARFUM' (size 22) is barely legible against the dark background.

changes.value: Empty deep burgundy red studio with matte wine-red paper floor and wall, large diagonal architectural shadow from upper right, flat geometric color fields, editorial still-life set, clear foreground left, subtle texture on surface
